rules: This addendum does not itself alter the 170-gap ledger or 362/365 release census; reconcile with canonical work keys and exact Gospel appointed texts before changes
Three candidates are from museum sources/partners but are NOT handpicked; a Commons listing does not authorize promotion
Never substitute a same-chapter or analogous episode for the exact Gospel
Do not misclassify a seventeenth-century print or Tissot gouache as an oil painting
Keep 27 protected Prayer NONE slots, previous owner selections and all original global rejections untouched

excludedFalsePositive.title: Farizeeën wijzen Christus op de discipelen die eten met ongewassen handen
excludedFalsePositive.reason: Museum classifies subject as Luke 11:37–41 (+ variant), so similar handwashing iconography alone does not prove Matthew 15:1–20. Do not promote this as exact Matthew.

excludedFalsePositive.title: The Pharisees Question Jesus
excludedFalsePositive.reason: Ambiguous among several disputes; no direct museum pericope verification in this audit and Tissot's sequence may locate the scene in another Jerusalem controversy. Do not rely on generic title or Wikipedia illustration for Matthew 15:1–20.

candidate.title: Jesus Speaks Near the Treasury (Jésus parle près du trésor)
candidate.museumRecordStatus: Museum partner Commons accession and 2006 source file corroborated; current direct original museum object URL not accessible
candidate.qualifier: John 8:20 identifies the Treasury as the place Jesus spoke; John 8:21 begins 'Again therefore Jesus said' in that setting. However the picture's title alone cannot certify that specific 8:21–29 discourse rather than adjacent 8:12–20.

records.needs: Curatorial citation binding the particular image to John 8:21–29, or another painting explicitly depicting that discourse

candidate.title: Two or Three Gathered in my Name (Deux ou trois personnes assemblées en mon nom)
candidate.museumRecordStatus: Museum catalogue indexed and confirms tags Matthew 18:18–20, official image file 00.159.43_PS2.jpg
candidate.qualifier: Direct depiction of verse 20 within the appointed March 10 Gospel range, but not a depiction of Peter's question and the forgiveness reply in 18:21–22. Treat as a subset, not entire pericope.

records.needs: Source-image eligibility, high-resolution, mobile crop and editorial selection

candidate.title: Christus in gesprek met de farizeeën en schriftgeleerden
candidate.artist: Christoffel van Sichem II, after Antonie Wierix II and a design by Bernardino Passeri
candidate.medium: woodcut printed in an album; not oil
candidate.museumRecordStatus: Direct museum catalogue states Pharisees and scribes from Jerusalem object to disciples eating with unwashed hands, with dispute and washing shown separately; 1629 copy after Wierix for Nadal's 1593 Evangelicae Historiae Imagines
candidate.qualifier: Exact subject of Matthew 15:1–2 within 1–20; copy/derivation must be accurately credited. Museum gives print size 103 x 74 mm; inspect text letters and detail at phone scale.

records.needs: Museum image-download rights and high resolution, original Wierix impression comparison, mobile readability; prefer more aesthetically suitable original oil work when found
